field_definitions.road_count: count of <road> elements at root level
field_definitions.junction_count: count of <junction> elements at root level
field_definitions.lane_section_count: count of <laneSection> elements across all roads
field_definitions.lane_record_count: total count of <lane> elements across all <laneSection> elements; each lane instance in each section counts once
field_definitions.unique_lane_key_count: count of unique (road_id, lane_section_s, lane_id) triples across all lanes; avoids double-counting lanes that appear in multiple sections
field_definitions.driving_lane_record_count: count of <lane> elements with type="driving" across all <laneSection> elements
field_definitions.roads_with_driving_lanes: count of roads that have at least one <lane type="driving"> in any <laneSection>
field_definitions.total_road_length_m: sum of road@length across all <road> elements
field_definitions.total_reference_line_length_m: sum of planView/geometry@length across all roads
field_definitions.connected_components: connected components over road links + junction membership using union-find; roads connected by road-type predecessor/successor or shared junction
field_definitions.largest_component_road_count: number of roads in the component with the largest total road length
field_definitions.largest_component_length_m: total road length of the largest component
field_definitions.semantic_objects: object inventory by class (barrier, building, pole, tree, crosswalk, etc.) from <object> elements
field_definitions.road_class_misclassified_length_ratio: fraction of road length with highway class differing from manual reference
field_definitions.predecessor_declared_rate_road_type: fraction of roads declaring at least one road-type predecessor
field_definitions.successor_declared_rate_road_type: fraction of roads declaring at least one road-type successor
field_definitions.pred_reciprocal_valid_rate_among_declare: among declared road-type predecessors, fraction with reciprocal successor in target road
field_definitions.succ_reciprocal_valid_rate_among_declare: among declared road-type successors, fraction with reciprocal predecessor in target road
field_definitions.dangling_roads_no_link: roads with no <link> element or no predecessor/successor children of any elementType
field_definitions.valid_LaneLinks: LaneLinks where predecessor and successor id references match existing lane keys
field_definitions.invalid_LaneLinks: LaneLinks with invalid or missing id references
field_definitions.contactPoint_valid: count of <contactPoint> elements with side="left" or side="right"
field_definitions.contactPoint_invalid: count of <contactPoint> elements with other or missing side values
field_definitions.perceptual_gap: BLOCKED - no comparable sensor evidence in this campaign
